analyses.title: Inheritance and storage consistency
analyses.detail: Global templates must not be represented as portfolio-owned. Image ownership is a many-to-many SQLite relation separate from a single physical asset. Cascade deletion must preserve other projects' ownership and active references.

solutions.title: Implementation direction
solutions.detail: Use system-wide template entities and dependency tracking; propagate master changes to all descendants. Model assets, project ownership and usage references separately in SQLite; apply foreign keys and transactional cascades plus guarded asset garbage collection.

solutions.title: Target schema and rollout strategy for development reset vs future durable migrations
solutions.detail:
1. Scope: development-stage migration design only; old V77 JSON workspace is a known interim representation, not the target relational model (FND-003).
2. Prefer an explicit clean DEV reset of SQLite and disposable test workspaces if backfill is disproportionately risky; obtain no additional permission for that same current test data. NEVER silently reset databases after real user data is in use.
3. Define persistent entities with unique stable IDs: projects, portfolios (project_id FK), globally reusable master/page templates (not project-owned), pages (portfolio_id FK), immutable content-addressed asset files, independent project-to-image ownership, global/public catalog membership, and image usage links. Physical deduplication is separate from ownership.
4. Enforce foreign keys and explicit ownership/reference constraints. Delete dependent project content without deleting globally shared templates or physical images still owned/referenced anywhere; defer asset GC until reference coverage is proven.
5. Make SQLite schema upgrades revisioned and transactional; after development reset phase, preserve all real data through additive migrations, backups, rollback/recovery and consistency checks.
6. Separate two mechanisms: (A) schema evolution is an application-startup DB version upgrade; (B) editing Master Template is an ordinary design update which immediately changes all dependent pages via live inheritance and independent per-page visibility/z-index overrides. Do not re-save inherited elements as mutable copies.
7. Define acceptance criteria before implementation: independent project/portfolio persistence across restart, shared global template edits visible in every dependent project, no cross-project library leakage, permanent image ownership, backup/restore of asset bytes and references, and safe project deletion.
8. Do not alter runtime data, run migrations/tests/builds, or claim implementation/owner acceptance under this planning task. Subsequent implementation and runtime review must be separately tracked.
solutions.scope_note: Historical design retained for durable native migrations, but Master Template propagation and old live inheritance sections are superseded for Browser by DEC-012. Native SQLite is deferred_native_sqlite; disposable DEV data migration is not required.

solutions.title: Image library ownership/scope alignment for future implementation
solutions.detail:
1. Current source: SHA-256 immutable media_store physical files (src-tauri/src/media_store.rs:30-56), one active project imageLibrary in JS (index.html:1148-1166), and fixed workspace image_files/image_refs/scene_links (main.rs:46-85; media_store.rs:159-230). These are NOT project/global multi-owner semantics.
2. Target: asset_files(hash) is the sole immutable physical byte store; logical image records are distinct from asset hash; project_asset_ownership(project_id,image_id or hash) is durable many-to-many; public image catalog state is independent of any single project.
3. Granting ownership to project B is additive and irreversible from project A, without byte copying. Public access is one-way; simply viewing/using a public image does not grant project ownership. Explicit Add to Project Library creates ownership.
4. Maintain independent active usage edges from page/template/tile cells (including hidden stash) and backups. Deletion checks usage before removing project-specific ownership. Project cascade can clear its records but cannot delete any physical asset with ownership, usage or backup references elsewhere.
5. Do not enable physical asset deletion/garbage collection until full reference coverage across projects, global templates, tile stash and backups is established and owner-reviewed.
6. Separate read-only Global Library view from per-project library; crossing a project boundary must not accidentally copy/revoke an image or expose private photos.
7. Respect existing source modifications by other developers: work from fresh main HEAD, minimize conflicts with frontend image tile/crop feature code, and make ownership backend changes in a separate implementation commit.
8. Images root: existing writable Tauri storage/assets and DEC-003 proposed images/ beside index.html are not equivalent without deployment-specific design. Preserve this divergence visibly until implementation resolves storage-root behavior; never assume packaged UI directory is writable.
9. Current owner has authorized clearing development TEST data if necessary; production migration/backup/restore and integrity remain mandatory before real data is used.

findings.detail:
index.html enqueue() catches each rejected write and reports it only when rev===revision, while a later success sets completed=latestRevision, clears lastError and makes flushStorage() succeed. When save A and save B are queued and A fails but B succeeds (especially distinct pages), A can remain unpersisted while the user sees Saved. This is a source-supported failure path; reproduction remains owner-only.
Source evidence: index.html:5708-5725. Build/Test/Runtime not executed.

Normal load_project_state() calls hydrate_payload(), whose fetch_image() returns an error for missing/corrupt asset files/metadata; the error aborts the whole load. Source evidence: src-tauri/src/media_store.rs:101-155; src-tauri/src/main.rs:53-62; index.html:5844-5847. Build/Test/Runtime not executed.

findings.title: Fallback خاموش از IndexedDB به localStorage باعث ایجاد دو شاخه داده می‌شود
findings.detail:
در شروع نسخه مرورگر، خطای openBrowser()/IndexedDB در index.html:5870 بدون انتخاب و هشدار مسدودکننده باعث mode='localStorage' می‌شود. v13ReadInitialState() پیشاپیش از localStorage داده می‌خواند، در حالی که نسخه معتبر احتمالی IndexedDB در آن لحظه قابل دسترس نیست. ویرایش/Save بعدی در localStorage انجام می‌شود و هنگام بازگشت IndexedDB محتوای دیگری نمایش داده خواهد شد. این خطر Split-brain و سردرگمی درباره محل نسخه معتبر است؛ شکست در اجرای واقعی هنوز آزمایش نشده.
Source evidence: index.html#L558-L564; index.html#L5688-L5706; index.html#L5869-L5873. No Build/Test/runtime executed.

findings.title: بکاپ نام‌دار الزاماً Snapshot تأییدشده همان Revision دیتابیس نیست
findings.detail:
V.createBackup() بعد از save()/flushStorage نسخه دلخواه backupPayload() فرانت‌اند را به create_backup ارسال می‌کند. backupPayload() پیش‌نویس Master/Section را نیز روی Snapshot اعمال می‌کند. Backend با payload=Some آن را می‌پذیرد و فقط کمپکت/صحت فایل‌های Asset را اعتبارسنجی می‌کند؛ از snapshot رابطه‌ای تاییدشده و شماره Revision به عنوان منبع قطعی استفاده نمی‌کند. میان ACK ذخیره و ساخت بکاپ امکان تغییر توسط پنجره دیگر نیز وجود دارد. بکاپ می‌تواند با آخرین وضعیت قطعی SQLite متفاوت باشد؛ این اختلاف به خودی خود اثبات خرابی فایل نیست.
Source evidence: index.html#L5777-L5789; index.html#L5867-L5867; src-tauri/src/main.rs#L359-L397. No Build/Test/runtime executed.

findings.title: دکمه خروجی بازیابی هنگام خطای بارگذاری ممکن است داده حافظه را جای داده واقعی معرفی کند
findings.detail:
در خطای load_project_state و startup، catch index.html:5873 دکمه «خروجی JSON از داده فعلی» را به download() وصل می‌کند؛ state اولیه از localStorage یا defaultState ساخته شده و در این مسیر لزوماً از SQLite شکست‌خورده بازیابی نشده است. download() از state فعلی خروجی می‌گیرد و هیچ کپی خام از DB/WAL/Assets یا Snapshot قابل اعتبارسنجی ارائه نمی‌کند. بنابراین خروجی می‌تواند نسخه معتبر پیشین را نمایندگی نکند؛ در خطای Asset این ریسک با TASK-041 هم‌پوشانی دارد ولی مسئله پیام/منبع ریکاوری مستقل است.
Source evidence: index.html#L556-L564; index.html#L1544-L1547; index.html#L5869-L5873. No Build/Test/runtime executed.

findings.title: Rollback پایگاه داده نمی‌تواند فایل‌های موقت یا Asset منتشرشده را خودکار برگرداند
findings.detail:
media_store::store_file تصویر immutable را در assets/{hash}.pending نوشته و پیش از اتمام transaction دیتابیس به assets/{hash}.{ext} rename می‌کند. سپس INSERT جدول asset_files و سایر مراحل save_project/save_page ممکن است rollback شوند. بنابراین فایل فیزیکی یا pending می‌تواند بدون رکورد نهایی باقی بماند. این خطر orphan/storage growth است، نه اثبات پاک‌شدن تصویر دارای ارجاع؛ GC عمداً طبق N-07 خاموش است.
Source evidence: src-tauri/src/media_store.rs#L30-L56; src-tauri/src/main.rs#L111-L124; src-tauri/src/main.rs#L214-L290. No Build/Test/runtime executed.

findings.title: خروجی قدیمی یک پورتفولیو می‌تواند پروژه‌های دیگر را نیز افشا کند
findings.detail:
Legacy v30ExportPortfolio copies the entire current state, narrows snapshot.portfolios but retains projectWorkspaces and other unrelated project/global fields. The v28/v29 portfolio action still invokes this legacy function. A file presented as one portfolio can therefore contain private records and assets belonging to other projects. The scoped v111ExportPortfolio is a separate implementation; no runtime execution was performed.
Source evidence: index.html#L5245-L5248; index.html#L5546-L5559; index.html#L1051-L1066. Source review only; no Build/Test/runtime acceptance.

findings.title: هم‌نام بودن شناسه یا Hash تصویر می‌تواند تصویر اشتباهی را در Import جایگزین کند
findings.detail:
Portfolio export includes publicImages id/hash/src, but portfolio import skips all source-content checks when a public image with the same ID exists at destination (if(publicAsset)continue). Private-image dedupe also trusts declared a.hash===imported.hash before validating actual imported.src bytes. Cross-installation ID/hash collisions or manipulated metadata may silently bind a different image. This is independent of TASK-041 missing-file load.
Source evidence: index.html#L1381-L1390; index.html#L1435-L1455; index.html#L1942-L1946. Source review only; no Build/Test/runtime acceptance.

findings.title: وابستگی قالب و استایل با شناسه موجود سنجیده می‌شود، نه با محتوای واقعی آن
findings.detail:
Project export explicitly drops globalTemplates and styleLibrary and only sets requiresSharedCatalog:true; portfolio export has no shared-catalog revision/fingerprint manifest. Project import substitutes the destination global catalog; the normalizer verifies referenced IDs exist but not that same-ID templates, section designs, styles, or inherited scene content match those used at export. Portfolio import also inherits current global definitions. An imported design may therefore be valid yet visually different without a conflict warning.
Source evidence: index.html#L1373-L1409; index.html#L1381-L1390; index.html#L1455-L1465; index.html#L518-L548. Source review only; no Build/Test/runtime acceptance.

findings.title: نتیجه نرمال‌سازی Import پورتفولیو دور ریخته می‌شود
findings.detail:
The portfolio import builds next, calls v13NormalizeProject(normalized), then discards its returned deep-cloned normalized state. It commits target.portfolios with the earlier clone, even when normalization would supply missing legacy defaults (for instance visualObjects/layers/page fields). A later native Save Page requires a normalized page. This is a source-level mismatch; actual failure depends on imported legacy input.
Source evidence: index.html#L1429-L1465; index.html#L468-L469; index.html#L537-L549; src-tauri/src/main.rs#L208-L225. Source review only; no Build/Test/runtime acceptance.

findings.title: خروجی بزرگ‌تر از ۸۰MiB تولید می‌شود ولی همان Import آن را رد می‌کند
findings.detail:
v111BackupJSON emits arbitrary-sized JSON blobs (including base64 media), but v111ReadBackup always rejects files larger than 80 MiB. A valid project/portfolio exported by this application may be impossible to import using its matching scoped command; the restriction is not disclosed before export.
Source evidence: index.html#L1314-L1332; index.html#L1373-L1390. Source review only; no Build/Test/runtime acceptance.

findings.title: Import از بکاپ چندپورتفولیویی بدون انتخاب کاربر فقط اولین پورتفولیو را برمی‌دارد
findings.detail:
When a source is not kind NSP-Portfolio-Backup, v111ImportPortfolio accepts backup.state?.portfolios?.[0]. A full workspace JSON containing multiple portfolios silently selects index 0 regardless of the intended portfolio, and the confirmation names only this selected one. A project export uses a different envelope. No author intent is inferred from a file just because it contains a state object.
Source evidence: index.html#L1418-L1432; index.html#L1373-L1390. Source review only; no Build/Test/runtime acceptance.

findings.title: جابه‌جایی صفحات با Save Page انجام می‌شود و ترتیب پایدار ممکن است ثبت نشود
findings.detail:
In project-mode thumbnail sidebar, v85MovePage mutates state.pages order but invokes generic save(). When the page editor is active, save() dispatches to V.queuePageSave and the native save_page transaction updates one page payload, not workspace_pages.position or global portfolio order. The UI then renders the reordered list and may report a successful page save although the structural order can revert on reload. Previous TASK-022/TASK-025 cover UI functionality and TASK-036 the Save separation, but none explicitly tracked this call-site regression.
Source evidence: index.html#L3805-L3814; index.html#L3820-L3820; index.html#L3843-L3850; index.html#L5724-L5725; src-tauri/src/main.rs#L208-L285; src-tauri/src/project_store.rs#L388-L403. Source-only review, no Runtime/Build/Test.

findings.title: مسیر Print پیش از پایان ناوبری ناهمگام، پیش‌نمایش را می‌خواند
findings.detail:
V125 changed go(destination) to an async leave guard that may await page persistence or master/section draft confirmation. Legacy v30PrintPortfolio swaps state.pages, calls go('preview') without awaiting the promise, then immediately queries '#app .print-zone', creates a print snapshot and restores state.pages in finally. From an edited page with pending save/draft, printing can inspect stale DOM or fail while navigation continues later; a rejected leave must not produce a misleading print snapshot. The generic printAll preflight also calls go('preview') without awaiting.
Source evidence: index.html#L4590-L4613; index.html#L5561-L5586; index.html#L5426-L5435; index.html#L1471-L1477. Source-only review, no Runtime/Build/Test.

findings.title: نوار کناری ۲۳۵ پیکسلی در عرض کوچک همچنان ثابت می‌ماند
findings.detail:
The main .shell stays grid-template-columns:235px minmax(0,1fr)!important even below the 850px and 650px media breakpoints. The breakpoint changes nav contents into two columns but does not stack/collapse the parent side rail. The 165px page thumbnail sidebar and designer dock remain inside the now narrower main column. This is a concrete source-level responsive-layout gap; exact overflow and usability are not runtime-verified. Native Tauri minWidth is 800px, but browser and constrained window widths still need a contract.
Source evidence: index.html#L2-L3; index.html#L5529-L5532; index.html#L5479-L5494; src-tauri/tauri.conf.json. Source-only review, no Runtime/Build/Test.

findings.title: بازشدن پروژه‌ها و نقش دکمه در کارت صفحه فاقد ساختار و فوکوس مناسب است
findings.detail:
Project expand/collapse buttons display only +/− with aria-expanded but no project-specific accessible name/controlled-region reference; v77ToggleProject calls render() which replaces #nav and #app via innerHTML without restoring the clicked control's focus. Page thumbnail items are div role=button/tabindex=0 while containing actual action buttons for reorder/copy/delete, making nested interactive structure confusing for keyboard/screen-reader navigation. Pointer/keyboard click routing exists but semantic/focus continuity is not guaranteed.
Source evidence: index.html#L1147-L1150; index.html#L1491-L1496; index.html#L1507-L1527; index.html#L3784-L3803; index.html#L3815-L3830. Source-only review, no Runtime/Build/Test.

findings.title: انتخاب فایل پروژه و تصاویر با ورودی مخفی از مسیر Tab قابل دستیابی نیست
findings.detail:
The system-level project import uses a <label class=btn> wrapping a file input with hidden; private/public Image Library uses the same label + input style='display:none' pattern. Neither label is focusable by default, and the hidden input is not in normal keyboard Tab order; pointer clicking a label can open the picker but a keyboard-only user lacks an equivalent focusable upload control. This is independent of the persisted import data contracts covered by TASK-026 and phase 03.
Source evidence: index.html#L572-L572; index.html#L834-L848; index.html#L850-L859; index.html#L1311-L1332. Source-only review, no Runtime/Build/Test.

findings.title: Resize با ماوس می‌تواند فرزندان Region Block را بیرون قاب باقی بگذارد
findings.detail:
The numeric property() path checks every existing Block child against the proposed frame after any x/y/w/h change. However pointerMove for a Region Block builds child patches only when blockResizeMode==='proportional'. In the 'frame' resize mode, changes contains only the Block; its frame passes v98BoundsValid but unchanged children are never checked against the new frame. A top/left/right/bottom frame shrink can therefore leave an attached child outside the Block, despite the document/Block containment invariant. No runtime repro was performed.
Source evidence: index.html#L2513-L2516; index.html#L3990-L4002; index.html#L4044-L4055; index.html#L4263-L4272; index.html#L4280-L4322. No Build/Test/runtime conducted.

findings.title: تراز و تکثیر هوشمند محدوده چرخش و Pivot را کنترل نمی‌کنند
findings.detail:
property() uses v98BoundsValid to check the four rotated/flipped corners around transformPivot. In contrast, v97Duplicate preflights only nx,ny,nx+w,ny+h and v96Apply preflights only x,y,x+w,y+h against document/Block bounds. For rotated objects near document/Region Block edges, a copied or aligned object may pass these axis-aligned checks even while its rendered transformed corners exceed the clipping surface; the aligned bounds also use raw w/h rather than visual bounding boxes. This gap is source-supported; exact UI outcome is pending runtime review.
Source evidence: index.html#L2625-L2639; index.html#L2747-L2832; index.html#L3990-L4002; index.html#L4044-L4047. No Build/Test/runtime conducted.

findings.title: Snap راهنما با Clamp مستقل می‌تواند شکل گروه را تغییر دهد
findings.detail:
pointerMove represents a Group/multi-selection movement with a common dx/dy. v83SnapMoves chooses one x and y correction but then clamps each child's values.x and values.y independently to page edges. If a selection spans the page width and a guide matches one member, another member against the opposite edge may be clamped while its peer moves. That silently changes relative distances despite an intended rigid group translation, and the later validator checks each object's bounds but not pairwise offsets.
Source evidence: index.html#L2507-L2532; index.html#L3101-L3121; index.html#L4263-L4272; index.html#L4309-L4322. No Build/Test/runtime conducted.

findings.title: History از تغییر راهنماها، پس‌زمینهٔ صفحه و Legacy Flow بی‌خبر است
findings.detail:
objectSnapshot and v91ContentSnapshot track objects, styles and layer/order fields, but not designGuides, guidesVisible or legacyLayout. v83MutateGuide and the pageBackground/content-flow handlers directly mutate the page and queue storage without calling commit(), so these edits neither create a History step nor participate in session Undo/Redo. The pageBackground handler also lacks a local rollback when the queue rejects a save before acceptance. This is an explicit gap within existing TASK-012 History scope, TASK-023/038 persistence handling and TASK-013 Guides; no duplicate new task is required.
Acceptance update: Extend TASK-012 acceptance to include reversible editor guide additions/deletions/moves/visibility, page background reset/color and legacy content-flow toggles with atomic history snapshots, correct redo invalidation, scoped Save Page persistence and rollback/error feedback. Preserve current session-only history and do not add zoom/pan or persisted historical metadata.
Source evidence: index.html#L2903-L2923; index.html#L2947-L2952; index.html#L3032-L3054; index.html#L3399-L3414; index.html#L3982-L3988; index.html#L4496-L4500. No Build/Test/runtime conducted.

findings.title: کد یتیم بیرون تابع M.place موجب توقف راه‌اندازی ابزارهای تصویر می‌شود
findings.detail:
After `M.place=function(id,forceNew=false){...};` closes at line 2056, duplicated placement statements remain at the IIFE top level (2057-2063). Line 2063 evaluates `if(!forceNew&&...)`, but `forceNew` is defined only as an M.place parameter, not in this outer lexical scope. The image initialization IIFE therefore throws ReferenceError during script evaluation, stopping subsequent registration of M.grid, M.markup, M.openPicker, mask/crop extensions and their event handlers. Source check found no other forceNew declaration in index.html. No runtime execution is claimed. This is not a new feature request; it is a bootstrap-blocking code defect.
Source evidence: index.html#L2030-L2064; index.html#L2064-L2112; index.html#L2125-L2185; index.html#L4536-L4545. Source-only, no runtime acceptance.

findings.title: جایگزینی اصل تصویر با همان شناسه، قرارداد تغییرناپذیری Asset را نقض می‌کند
findings.detail:
In M.replaceAsset, the gallery lets the user choose an unrelated file and then uses `Object.assign(old,fresh,{id})`, retaining the existing library image ID while changing src/hash and other immutable-original metadata. All page elements referencing that ID now resolve to a different image without replacing their own bindings, and ownership projections can migrate the ID to a different physical hash. Only exact public-src matches are blocked. This is a deliberate operation in the UI but contradicts BR-004/REQ-011 no direct replacement of the original image library asset and is distinct from valid element-level M.place binding replacement.
Source evidence: index.html#L1945-L1948; index.html#L2030-L2055; src-tauri/src/image_ownership.rs#L157-L171; src-tauri/src/image_ownership.rs#L307-L333. Source-only, no runtime acceptance.

findings.title: تعداد زیاد ستون با Gap بزرگ باعث سلول‌های Tile بدون فضای قابل نمایش می‌شود
findings.detail:
M.grid accepts rows/cols up to 12 and gap up to 60px independently, and adjusts the object frame width/height by clamping to available document bounds. It never verifies that (cols-1)*gap fits inside the resulting object width (or rows for height). For example 12 columns × 60px gaps require 660px of horizontal gap alone, more than a 595px page; M.markup still renders a CSS grid with 12 `minmax(0,1fr)` tracks, so image cells can collapse or be clipped. The grid can remain serialized and stash referenced images despite unusable visible cells.
Source evidence: index.html#L2010-L2013; index.html#L2064-L2069; index.html#L2071-L2093; index.html#L2105-L2112. Source-only, no runtime acceptance.

findings.title: رسم و ویرایش رأس‌های ماسک چندضلعی فقط با اشاره‌گر ممکن است
findings.detail:
M.editCustomMask creates SVG polygon/circle vertices with only pointerdown/pointermove events for adding, moving and selecting points. The vertices are SVG circles with no tabindex, keyboard handlers, accessible coordinate editor or alternative numeric per-vertex controls. A keyboard-only user can open the dialog and remove/clear points via buttons but cannot construct or move the polygon vertices needed to apply a custom mask. This is a distinct image-editor accessibility gap, not a claim that the existing pointer UI fails.
Source evidence: index.html#L2221-L2269; index.html#L1994-L2008. Source-only, no runtime acceptance.

findings.title: Crop و ابزار تنظیم تصویر باید خطای ذخیره و محدوده مقادیر را صریح نشان دهند
findings.detail:
M.crop's Apply handler checks the media-context token but calls writeCell(...) and closes the dialog unconditionally, unlike editCustomMask where a false writeCell result leaves the dialog open and reports failure. M.adjust clamps only grayscale, sepia, blur and sharpen, but directly stores out-of-range zoom, x/y, brightness/contrast/saturation and radius values; frame() merely clamps them at display time, producing a mismatch between saved JSON and shown pixels. Existing TASK-020 and TASK-029 already own crop/filter semantics, and TASK-038 covers queued failure acknowledgement, so register a linked finding and enhance acceptance rather than creating a duplicate task.
Additional acceptance: In TASK-020/029, validate and normalize all image-edit limits before write, keep the Crop/Mask dialog open and report when writeCell rejects the edit, distinguish queue acknowledgement from synchronous enqueue, and preserve exact per-tile editor/preview/print settings with explicit rollback/retry. No assistant-run Build/Test.
Source evidence: index.html#L2010-L2029; index.html#L2105-L2111; index.html#L2263-L2274

findings.title: Preflight یک Image Tiles سالم را تصویر گم‌شده تشخیص می‌دهد
findings.detail:
M.tiles creates one type=image element with tilesJson cells, without requiring a top-level assetId. M.markup renders each visible cell asset; however collectIssues unconditionally checks `o.type==='image'&&!imagePresent(o)` before entering its Tile branch. imagePresent only inspects the container's direct assetId/src/image/dataUrl. Therefore valid filled Image Tiles are flagged as missingImage and printAll blocks printing with an error, even if all visible cells resolve. The Tile branch also loops `tiles.stash`, even though stash cells are dormant and are not rendered; it treats a missing hidden image as a printable missing-image error. Confirmed from source, not runtime.
Source evidence: index.html#L2134-L2136; index.html#L2151-L2153; index.html#L5337-L5344; index.html#L5365-L5401; index.html#L5468-L5477. Source-only; no runtime/PDF owner validation.

findings.title: چاپ می‌تواند پس از خطای بارگذاری تصویر یا پایان Timeout بدون بازبینی نهایی اجرا شود
findings.detail:
The preflight wrapper runs collectIssues before the oldPrintAll waits for fonts and image loading. In collectIssues, a raster img is marked broken only if `img.complete&&img.naturalWidth===0`; an image still loading is not an error yet. oldPrintAll then treats both image `load` and `error` as completion; after at most four seconds via Promise.race it always calls window.print() without recalculating broken resources or presenting unresolved-image warnings. SVG <image> readiness also resolves on error. A late failure or 4-second timeout can therefore proceed to a print/PDF with missing image content despite an earlier green preflight. This is separate from TASK-053 async navigation/print selection.
Source evidence: index.html#L1821-L1836; index.html#L1872-L1879; index.html#L5411-L5427; index.html#L5468-L5477; index.html#L5594-L5619. Source-only; no runtime/PDF owner validation.

findings.title: Preflight روی شماره صفحه پنهان کاور و قاب Region Block غیرچاپی هشدار می‌دهد
findings.detail:
The print renderer filters out pageNumber on the first page unless `showOnFirstPage===true`, and filters out Region Block frames whenever not rendering an editor. collectIssues loops all resolved doc.objects except explicit visible/renderVisible/layerVisible flags; it does not replicate the print-only page-number or Region Block filters. An invisible first-page page-number object or an editor-only Block frame near the configured safe margin may therefore create a bounds/margin warning even when that object is not in the printable output. No runtime screen-reader/print output observed.
Source evidence: index.html#L1723-L1730; index.html#L1740-L1759; index.html#L1785-L1801; index.html#L5365-L5383. Source-only; no runtime/PDF owner validation.

findings.title: DPI هشدار چاپ برای Fit/Fill/Cover از یک فرمول یکسان استفاده می‌کند
findings.detail:
v113PrintDpi calculates min(croppedPixelWidth/printFrameWidth, croppedPixelHeight/printFrameHeight)/zoom for every image and tile, without taking objectFit or actual visual image size into account. Shared frame rendering supports contain, cover, fill and none, with different effective image-to-paper scale. Example: an 800×200 px image in a 2×2 inch frame with contain is drawn 2×0.5 inches and has approximately 400 actual image pixels per printed inch, but the formula yields min(400,100)=100 and may warn below 200 DPI. Conversely, other modes can produce different effective sample densities. This is an unverified analytical example, not measured PDF output. Existing TASK-029 explicitly owns image-quality and effective-DPI warnings, so no duplicate task is created.
Acceptance supplement for TASK-029: Extend TASK-029 to derive effective pixels-per-printed-inch from actual crop dimensions, zoom, SVG/frame objectFit=contain|cover|fill|none, transformed image size and paper orientation/size, per Tile and main image. Label calculated estimates and unknown source sizes honestly; owner compares Fit/Fill/Cover/None known-pixel fixtures and A4/A3 printed/PDF output. Source image originals remain immutable.
Source evidence: index.html#L2147-L2153; index.html#L5345-L5355; index.html#L5379-L5398

findings.title: Save Page در SQLite بی‌دلیل JSON تمام Workspace را می‌سازد
findings.detail:
V.queuePageSave() always calls JSON.stringify(page) AND JSON.stringify(state), including all inactive projects and Base64 image libraries, before enqueue. SQLite writePage() only passes the page payload to save_page and never consumes the full `portable` snapshot; it is used exclusively for browser IndexedDB/localStorage monolithic storage. Thus every small native Save Page synchronously allocates an otherwise unused complete workspace copy (potentially multiple queued copies) and spends main-thread CPU scaling with all projects/assets rather than the edited page. This is independent of browser CAS correctness and the existing masked-failure ledger.

findings.title: خواندن/نوشتن فایل تصاویر در حین نگهداری تراکنش SQLite انجام می‌شود
findings.detail:
load_project_state() takes Storage(Mutex<Connection>), begins SQLite transaction, then calls hydrate_payload(), which performs filesystem reads, SHA-256 validation and Base64 encoding before committing. save_project() and save_page() call media_store::compact_value inside a SQLite write transaction; store_file may decode files, read existing originals, fsync new temporary files and rename them. Consequently long I/O, hashing and JSON conversions extend transaction/connection lock occupancy, delaying other commands and potentially prolonging WAL reader lifetimes. This source-level lock exposure is independent of the CAS/lost-update safeguards; no latency or contention measurement has been executed.
Source evidence: src-tauri/src/main.rs#L36-L62; src-tauri/src/main.rs#L111-L125; src-tauri/src/main.rs#L214-L252; src-tauri/src/media_store.rs#L30-L56; src-tauri/src/media_store.rs#L101-L156. Source-only; no performance measurements or owner runtime acceptance.

findings.title: بارگذاری همه تصاویر به Base64 در حافظه مصرف RAM را با رشد پروژه افزایش می‌دهد
findings.detail:
hydrate_payload() eagerly replaces every immutable image reference in the entire workspace (including non-active project catalogs, snapshots and tilesJson) with a full Base64 data URL, caches those strings and clones them for repeated references. It then serializes the entire hydrated tree into one string, after which the frontend JSON.parse and v13NormalizeProject deep-copy the complete state. This produces several simultaneously live representations of many image bytes during startup and can amplify memory with repeated references even if pages/assets are not visible. No actual RAM profile or crash measurement was conducted.
Source evidence: src-tauri/src/media_store.rs#L101-L156; src-tauri/src/main.rs#L45-L62; index.html#L347-L349; index.html#L468-L470; index.html#L556-L564. Source-only; no performance measurements or owner runtime acceptance.

findings.title: فایل JSON کامل و آپلود تصویر بدون بودجه حجم و Decode پردازش می‌شوند
findings.detail:
Scoped v111ReadBackup enforces an 80 MiB file cap, but global importData() directly awaits file.text(), JSON.parse() and the deep-copy normalizer with no file-length, nesting-depth, array-count or decoded-image budget. Image import prepare(file) similarly reads the whole file as a data URL, decodes it into Image/canvas, then calls file.arrayBuffer() for SHA-256 without an upfront file or pixel quota; native store_file() decodes arbitrarily long Base64 strings. Large or maliciously crafted user-supplied files can cause high peak RAM and a blocked UI or failed process before a clear recoverable validation error. This is a resource-exhaustion exposure, not evidence of code execution or a reproduced crash.
Source evidence: index.html#L1320-L1332; index.html#L1989-L1995; index.html#L6079-L6080; index.html#L5991-L6003; src-tauri/src/media_store.rs#L30-L37. Source-only; no performance measurements or owner runtime acceptance.

findings.title: تمام Thumbnailهای صفحات در هر Render دوباره محاسبه و ساخته می‌شوند
findings.detail:
v85PageSidebar maps all pages and computes V.resolvePage(p) then V.renderDocument(p,i+1) for every thumbnail. renderDocument resolves the page again and expands image/media markup; global render() replaces the app DOM, and multiple render wrappers refresh the editor even for selection/panel/navigation changes. With many pages/tiles/images, per-interaction work scales with the full portfolio and recreates preview DOM repeatedly; no visible-range virtualization, stable thumbnail cache or per-page invalidation is present in that path. This is an architectural performance finding, not a measured frame rate.
Source evidence: index.html#L3890-L3910; index.html#L3960-L3962; index.html#L572-L572; index.html#L1591-L1599; index.html#L1803-L1819. Source-only; no performance measurements or owner runtime acceptance.

findings.title: Save Project همچنان جداول سازگاری Legacy را کامل حذف و بازنویسی می‌کند
findings.detail:
Although N-03 ownership and N-05 scene projections are incremental, save_project() still issues DELETE FROM on all rows belonging to 'workspace' across image_files, image_refs, scene_links, scene_entities, pages, templates and images, then re-inserts all compatibility rows. The existing TASK-031 database optimization/architecture work is a better follow-up owner than duplicating it as a new task.

For retained rows use guarded diff/UPSERT and avoid full deletes on unchanged Save Project. Never delete actual asset files; owner compares SQL row churn, WAL growth, multiwindow saves and reopen.
Source evidence: src-tauri/src/main.rs#L153-L199; src-tauri/src/project_store.rs#L426-L490. Source-only.
